title: secale montanum subsp. dalmaticum
intro: Secale montanum subsp. dalmaticum, commonly known as Dalmatian rye grass or mountain rye, is a subspecies of the Secale montanum plant. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Secale montanum subsp. dalmaticum include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve menstrual cramps, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and spasmolytic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
